scope: example-only; replace with reviewed nonsecret project facts

aliases.notes: Do not infer from an alias or port alone. Confirm actual deployment identity.

rules: Aliases are labels, not discovery. Never store credentials, connection strings, tokens, or signed URLs.
Map only after checking authoritative project config or observed runtime identity.
Generate any lock key with the canonical resource_identity.py tool; a map alone does not lock or enforce access.
If two aliases may refer to one resource but evidence is incomplete, treat them as a potential collision and serialize or block conflicting writes until resolved.
Keep this map project-local. Cross-project shared-resource coordination needs an explicitly authorized, nonsecret common identity and the same host coordinator protocol.
